objective: Minimize operating energy use; purchase cost and payback are excluded from the decision.
boundary: Incremental AC input power for the entire enclosure: Ethernet, radios, sensors, the local switch and PoE losses are included. The existing HA/Matter/Z-Wave JS server and the shared baseline draw of existing network equipment are excluded as identical. For a new dedicated PSE, add any otherwise unaccounted baseline draw without double-counting losses already included in efficiency.
assumptions: 24/7, 365 days per year; no deep sleep, preserving RF reception, Thread routing and radar operation.
All input power values except the LD2450's specified average are scenario estimates; our assembly has not been measured.
The 70–88% efficiency applies to the complete power path at operating load, including its losses; it is not a specification for a particular splitter.
The lower and upper totals sum the scenario bounds; they are not a statistical confidence interval or a guaranteed maximum.
BLE scanning retains the 30/320 ms profile. Increasing it to 100% changes consumption; variants with different functionality must not be compared.
The specified measurement boundary for the SLZB-06 and switch is unclear; close rankings are unreliable before bench measurements.
The power calculation estimates energy use, not power supply or fuse ratings. Startup and TX peaks require separate checks.

cc.label: CC1101 continuously receiving
cc.note: Equivalent at the 5 V input; occasional transmissions, not continuous TX.

bme.label: BME680 breakout, 60 s sampling
bme.note: Estimate for the entire board, heater 150 ms/60 s; not a continuous 0.25 W.

pi.label: Raspberry Pi 4 + SD, OTBR

orange.label: Orange Pi One + SD, OTBR
orange.note: Historical measurements indicate the order of magnitude; current Armbian has not been measured.

usb_radios.label: USB Zigbee + USB Thread RCP
usb_radios.note: Assumed total for two dongles including supporting circuitry and LEDs; not a published specification.

usb_thread.label: USB Thread RCP
usb_thread.note: Assumed allowance for the complete dongle, not just the SoC current.

usb_hub.label: USB 2.0 hub without external PSU
usb_hub.note: No candidate selected; additional draw and backfeeding must be checked.

slzb.label: SLZB-06, equivalent 5 V input
slzb.note: Vendor: 1.5–3 W with an unknown measurement boundary. The 1.2–3 W used here is a conversion assumption, not a measurement; a major source of uncertainty.

hub_dev.label: S3 DevKit + W5500: BLE/sensors
hub_dev.note: Estimate at 240 MHz/PSRAM80 MHz; BLE scan 30/320 ms + up to 3 connections; external devices excluded.

rf_dev.label: S3 DevKit + W5500: RF host
rf_dev.note: 240 MHz, Wi-Fi disabled; CC1101 counted separately.

thread_dev.label: S3 + W5500 + H2: Thread BR

hub_buck.label: S3 + W5500: BLE, buck supply
hub_buck.note: Estimate for a board with switching 5→3.3 V conversion and no extra USB-UART; not a Waveshare measurement.

rf_buck.label: S3 + W5500: RF host, buck
rf_buck.note: CC1101 counted separately. The 85–92% buck efficiency is only an assumption.

thread_buck.label: S3 + W5500 + H2: Thread, buck
thread_buck.note: New power layout; a software build on a DevKit does not validate this board.

nodemcu.label: NodeMCU: existing RF host over Wi-Fi
nodemcu.note: Unverified estimate at the board's 5 V input; CC1101 counted separately; not an entirely wired variant.

sources.title: Waveshare 25 W PoE splitter
sources.note: No published efficiency curve for our load. 70–88% AC-to-5V efficiency including PoE cable is an assumption; the downstream low-voltage harness is counted separately.

sources.title: Espressif ESP32-P4 datasheet

sources.title: TI DP83825I Ethernet PHY

sources.title: ESPHome ESP-Hosted

sources.title: TI TPS23758EVM-080 efficiency at light load
sources.note: Example evaluation board: 61% at 48 V to 5 V / 230 mA, versus 85% at 1.15 A. Not our splitter; demonstrates why low-load efficiency needs its own test.

target.title: Compact board: 1 S3 + 1 Ethernet + local radios
target.description: One S3 with ESPHome/OTBR, one W5500, H2 Thread RCP, MG24 Zigbee NCP, ZAC93 through SC16IS752, CC1101, LD2450 and BME680. This is a target for a board under development, not a prototype measurement. See docs/low-power.md.
